text.ko: 업종 내 매우 약함. 약점: 잉여현금흐름 마진 1.9%.
text.en: Very weak within its sector. Weakness: Free cash flow margin 1.9%.

text.en: About average for its sector. Strength: Revenue growth consistency 100%. Weakness: 3-yr free cash flow growth -16.6%.

text.en: Weak within its sector. Strength: Days sales outstanding 35 days. Weakness: Asset age (accumulated depreciation share) 65.4%.

text.ko: 업종 내 우수. 강점: 주가순자산비율(PBR) 1.37x. 약점: PEG(성장 대비 PER) 적자/음수 · n/m.
text.en: Strong within its sector. Strength: Price to book 1.37x. Weakness: PEG ratio n/m (negative).

text.ko: 현재 경제 환경이 이 업종에 불리한 편이에요. 주요 요인: 금리 상승 국면 (불리).
text.en: The current economy tends to work against this sector. Main factor: rising rates (hurts).
